about: Shaded molecule bands for the Inspect rainbow spectrum chart. Every centre and every range comes from docs/BUILD_PROMPT.md section 8.16 'C. Spectrum view' item 1 ('Shaded, labeled molecule bands'). Where the build prompt gives only a centre ('near 1.4 um', 'H2O ice 3.0 um'), the range is a display width chosen by the web team (about one SPHEREx band either side, flagged per band in 'width'); the 'ice and dust' ranges are also the measurement bands of findFeatures in web/lib/inspect.ts. Please check against the literature before relying on the widths.
